credits: Grotte des Aluxes, Puerto Aventuras. Topographie degré 4 UIS, Expéditions Yuc 2001 / 2005 (French expeditions). Spelunca 98, p. 35, 2005 (Figure 15: Plan de la grotte des Aluxes). North arrow: magnetic north; 200 m scale bar
sistemaWhy: The database's sistema 'Alux' (area Puerto Aventuras) - the Grutas de los Aluxes. Not the Cueva Alux of Xpuha (maps/alux.json).
otherEditions: Same cave: 'Aluxes, Grutas de los, Puerto Aventuras (2).pdf' (Mafia Maps, F. Devos, July 2001: Gruta Norte only, 775 m, stick map with water pools, Entrances 1-3, Rancho, 'Footprints'), '(1).pdf' (Mafia Maps, August 2002, colour: Gruta Norte 775 m, Este 508 m, Oeste 1,032 m, Sur 1,498 m, total 3,814 m, stick map with the village (Poblado) and Carretera Federal 307) and 'Aluxes, Grutas de los, Puerto Aventuras.pdf' (the same 2002 map in grey, AMCS Activities Newsletter 26, p. 41, 2003). All md5-distinct; _data/maps-import/images holds webp copies of the Spelunca and the two wetworx maps. This Spelunca plan is the only one with walls.
placementWhy: No cave of this map has a database or OpenStreetMap position (the sistema 'Alux' has no cave). Placed by the surface features the map draws in red: the motorway (Autoroute = MEX 307) and the village road (Calle Vivoros, Puerto Aventuras' main entrance road, OSM 158026443) meeting it at a T - the map's two straight double lines, measured with a Hough fit. Three points: the junction of the two centrelines, a point 1,200 m NE along the motorway and one 500 m NW along the road (both at the scale bar's 0.4515 m/px). Free similarity fit: 0.4562 m/px (1% from the bar), rotation -2.0 deg; residuals 14.6, 5.4 and 13.1 m (the map's road-motorway angle is 84 deg against 81 on the ground: the road is drawn with a ruler). Checks: the 'Entrée du terrain de basket' (basketball court entrance) lands at the edge of the covered basketball court of the village (about 30 m from its centre) - the strongest confirmation; the map's village grid lies NE of the road's NW end, where the old village is; the SE branch straddles the motorway as drawn, and the concrete foundations (Fondations en béton) are under it. Doubt: the long 'Effondrement' collapse (NW branch) lands about 100 m NE of a NE-SW wooded strip in the town (two unbuilt blocks either side of an avenue, 210 m long, bearing 44 deg against the collapse's 280 m and 51 deg) - if that strip is the collapse, the NW branch is that far off (survey closure or drawing). Expect 20-40 m near the motorway, up to about 100 m at the NE ends of the north branch. The 2002 Mafia Maps line plot (another survey of the same cave, with Carretera Federal 307 and the Poblado) agrees in layout: Gruta Sur crossing the highway, Oeste in the village, Norte/Este 400-700 m NW of the highway.

symbols.why: No legend. No depths in the plan (the m figures are the cross-sections' heights and widths: 14, 8, 6, 3, 2.5 m); no bones (searched: no bones icon, no 'os'/'ossements' text); no water-flow arrows. The red dots (survey stations or speleothems, no legend) and the red surface features (motorway, village road and grid, 'Antenne') are not cave symbols. Place names at their labels; the 'Siphon' leaders end at the two ends of the isolated SW part's water.
